description: This file contains the implementation of a hosted background service and a grain for activation shedding simulation in an Orleans-based application. It manages grain activation, monitors memory usage, and logs statistics related to grain activity.

classes.name: ActivationSheddingToyHostedService
classes.description: A hosted background service that manages and monitors Orleans grain activation; it periodically triggers grain activity, monitors memory, and logs statistics.

classes.name: ActivationSheddingToyGrain
classes.description: A simple Orleans grain implementation that simulates activity by holding a buffer and providing a Ping method.

classes.name: IActivationSheddingToyGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface defining a Ping method for activation.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Main execution loop for the hosted service; manages grain activity, memory monitoring, and statistics collection.

methods.name: PrintUsage
methods.description: Logs current memory usage, activation count, and environment statistics during execution.

methods.name: PlotAndPrintStats
methods.description: Calculates and displays marginal memory usage per grain between collected data points.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A simple method on the grain to simulate activity.
